results.title: Appeals court blocks Trump’s $400M White House ballroom project
results.description: WASHINGTON >> A federal appeals court ordered Donald Trump’s administration today to stop construction on a $400 million ballroom on the site of the White House’s demolished East Wing, dealing the Republican leader a major setback in a case testing his presidential authority.

results.title: AM Best Affirms Credit Ratings of Global Indemnity Group, LLC and Its Subsidiaries
results.description: AM Best has affirmed the Financial Strength Rating (FSR) of A (Excellent) and the Long-Term Issuer Credit Ratings (Long-Term ICR) of “a” (Excellent) of the U.S. operating subsidiaries of Global Indemnity Group, LLC (Global Indemnity) (Delaware) [NASDAQ: GBLI]. Concurrently, AM Best has affirmed the Long-Term ICR of “bbb” (Good) of Global Indemnity. (See below for a complete list of companies and ratings.) The outlook of these Credit Ratings (ratings) is stable.

results.title: As Washington state’s AI task force winds down, the debate over how much to regulate is far from settled
results.description: Washington's AI task force wrapped up two years of work with the state's first AI laws on the books and its broader recommendations stalled in the Legislature. At a panel marking the end of the effort, consumer and labor advocates pushed for stronger rules while AI startups warned about the cost of complying. Read More
